NOTICE AND AGENDA
  FOR SPECIAL MEETING

UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE, MEETINGS WILL BE CONDUCTED PURSUANT TO THE PROVISIONS OF THE
ASSEMBLY BILL 361, WHICH ALLOWS COUNCIL MEMBERS TO PARTICIPATE FROM A REMOTE LOCATION
WITHOUT LISTING A PHYSICAL LOCATION. TO PROVIDE COMMENTS DURING A MEETING: YOU MAY
ATTEND THE MEETING, SEND AN EMAIL TO: publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, OR JOIN THE ZOOM
MEETING BY CALLING: (669) 900-6833 OR USING THE ZOOM APP WITH THE FOLLOWING LINK:
https://us02web.zoom.us/j/87993049026; WEBINAR ID: 879 9304 9026. THE MEETING MAY BE VIEWED
THROUGH ZOOM. THE QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS FEATURE WILL BE AVAILABLE DURING THE MEETING.

  NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Mayor of the City of Norwalk has called a special meeting of the City
Council beginning at 6:00 p.m. on September 19, 2022 at the Sproul Reception Center, 12239 Sproul Street, Norwalk,
CA and via videoconference. The agenda for the special meeting is as follows:

CALL TO ORDER / FLAG SALUTE  Mayor Ramirez

ROLL CALL  City Clerk

CITY COUNCIL OPENING REMARKS

REPORTS

1. PUBLIC SAFETY UPDATE – No action required.
2. PARKS AND RECREATION UPDATE – No action required.
3. PUBLIC SERVICES UPDATE – No action required.

QUESTIONS/ANSWERS – Staff will provide responses to questions in-person, submitted to
publiccomments@norwalkca.gov, via Zoom through the Questions and Answers feature, and by speaking during the
Zoom meeting on a variety of issues that may be of importance to the speaker or the community at large. Topics that
may be discussed include but are not limited to public safety, transportation, road conditions, City's budget, utility
issues, development, City departments, animal control, housing, and parks.

I, Theresa Devoy, City Clerk, hereby certify that the foregoing notice of special meeting was posted at City Hall not less than 24-
hours before the start of the meeting and delivered to each member of the Norwalk City Council and to the following newspapers:
Herald American, Cerritos Community News, Norwalk Patriot, and Whittier Daily News, all on the 15th day of September 2022.

Theresa Devoy, CMC, City Clerk
  Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda after it has been
  posted will also be made available for public inspection in the City Clerk’s Department.

  Public Comment: The public is encouraged to address the City Council.

  Americans with Disabilities Act: In compliance with the ADA, if you need special assistance to participate in a City
  meeting or other services offered by this City, please contact the City Clerk’s office, (562) 929-5720. Assisted listening
  devices are available at this meeting. Ask the City Clerk if you desire to use this device. Upon request, the agenda and
  documents in the agenda packet, can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability.
  Notification of at least 12 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist the City staff in assuring
  that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
